page.overview:
Who is Essa?

If asks about the , explains that is a tradition where people race around a course with a to see who is the fastest. She tells to exit from the of and head to the right to find the . Though it is off topic, she adds that has been talking strangely lately and wonders why.

Essa's job at the is part-time. Though it is difficult, she finds enjoyment in how happy the get when he puts out their food. She admits to feeding them too much sometimes.

At midnight, considers her work for the day to be done. With everything she does for the , the day just seems to fly away from her. According to her, whenever she lays out food for the , they rush over as quickly as they can to eat it. If speaks to while she is sleeping, she asks to be left alone.

During the "" , can find to the northwest of with a group of wild . She explains that asked her to go recruit some wild . While the in are faster and will wait for the rider, 's wild will run away when dismounted. She recommends renting a trained one, as she believes them to be worth it. Link can use one of her to ride through the in the .
